Alex —

Thanks again for the discovery session last week. Based on what you shared about your latency targets and multi-tenant routing requirements, our engineers recommend a follow-up technical deep-dive to validate topology, estimate throughput, and define a mutual action plan.

Proposed objectives for the call:
- Walk through your current inference topology and request patterns
- Identify model variants and quantization/serving fit
- Discuss routing/fallback and caching strategies for mixed workloads
- Align on integration checklist and ownership for a POC

Two slots that work for our pre-sales team (all times PDT):
- Wed Jun 16, 10:00–11:00 AM
- Thu Jun 17, 1:00–2:00 PM

If neither works, share a few times that do and we’ll accommodate. Please confirm who on your side should join (engineer + infra lead recommended). I’ve attached a short notes doc we’ll reference.

If you have any specific items you want on the agenda (throughput target, KV cache sizing, quantization baseline), drop them back and we’ll add them.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0132
